Class GeneratedMaterial

java.lang.Object
net.murat.material.GeneratedMaterial
All Implemented Interfaces:
Material
public class GeneratedMaterial extends Object implements Material
GeneratedMaterial - a fully configurable material created from user-defined parameters via the MaterialGenerator/UI system.

Supports multiple procedural patterns (solid, checkerboard, vertical gradient, wood rings, marble, brick, stripes, dots, noise, fractal) with configurable scale and frequency.

All lighting calculations are performed entirely in world space, exactly as the ray tracer provides them, ensuring correct results regardless of object transforms.

Fully GC-friendly with zero allocation during getColorAt().

      Description copied from interface: Material
      Calculates the final color at a given point on the surface, considering the material's properties and the light source.
      Specified by:
      getColorAt in interface Material
      Parameters:
      point - The point in 3D space (world coordinates) where the light hits.
